features.title: The shell opens, shows its content and renders after real input
features.acceptance: After the main window is shown and driven with pointer, wheel, text and key input, every kind of input has reached the application, the window is titled for the design it has open, its menu, canvas and status line are still in the visual tree, and a frame is rendered at the window's client size.

features.title: Resizing the shell re-lays-out and re-renders its content
features.acceptance: After the main window is resized twice with input in between, the canvas fills what the menu and the status line leave of the new client size each time, the view transform is told the new viewport, the model point at the centre of the view stays at the centre, and the next rendered frame has that size.

features.title: Keyboard traversal of the shell reaches its controls
features.acceptance: After a click on the drawing, three Tabs, a Shift-Tab, an unbound command chord and typed text, focus is on a focusable control of the shell, every key reached the window in the order it was pressed, and neither the open design nor the view transform changed.

features.title: A pointer session is delivered to the shell in order
features.acceptance: A hover, a drag along a four-point path, a double click, a wheel turn and a key press arrive at the window in order, with the left button held on every drag move and a click count of two on the second press, and the drag the window received is the drag that moved the view.

features.title: Unsaved changes are asked about before they are lost
features.acceptance: With an unsaved part drawn, Ctrl/Cmd+N asks to save first, and a click or Delete on the drawing under the question changes nothing; Escape cancels and keeps the drawing; File > Samples asks again, and Don't save opens the sample, which has no file for Save to write back to; after an edit, Ctrl/Cmd+O asks naming the sample, and Enter on the focused Save saves the sample to a new file of its own before the other file opens; after another edit, File > Exit asks, and Cancel keeps the window open with the edit in it.

features.title: Every menu and submenu opens inside a 900 x 600 window
features.acceptance: In the default look at 900 x 600 with the coffee table open, the menu bar reads File, Edit, Draw, View, Project, Lists; File, File > Samples, Edit, Draw, Draw > Walls, Draw > Stock, View, View > Standard views, View > Look along, View > Appearance > Theme, View > Appearance > Paper and line, Project, Project > Open designs in and Lists each open by mouse with every item inside the window; Lists > Fastener sizes and supplies opens the lists on the sizes tab, and Project > Saw kerf opens the cut layout with the kerf field focused.

features.title: Export the plan as DXF
features.acceptance: Coffee table from File > Samples, then File > Export plan as DXF: the file offered is Coffee table.dxf, it reads back as DXF 2000 with one closed outline per part and each dimension's label as plain text reading as the canvas labels it, with no DIMENSION entity, and the message bar says where it went; Ctrl/Cmd+N, R and a drag draw one part, and exporting again gives one closed outline at that part's corners and no dimension layer.
